tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background and the default ground for everything. Near-white in light, green-tinted near-black in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers, and the fill of disabled controls and neutral tags. Decorative only; not for borders that carry meaning (use ink or ink-muted).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on paper (17.9:1 light, 16.0:1 dark), leaf-soft (14.8 / 10.9) and alert-soft. Also the bold block colour (dark in light, light in dark: an inverse block) and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on paper (6.9:1 light, 7.8:1 dark) and leaf-soft (5.7 / 5.3). Also input borders on paper.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on ink blocks (8.4:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Prominent panels: dark in both themes, charcoal on the dark page.

tokens.name: panel-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and light control outlines on panel.

tokens.name: panel-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, disabled labels and unearned stars on panel.

tokens.name: panel-accent
tokens.usage: Links, earned stars and focus rings on panel.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The brand green (Grass), the same in both themes: primary buttons, big colour blocks, and icons or borders that carry meaning on paper (3.1:1 light, 5.8:1 dark). Not for text on paper; use leaf-ink. On ink blocks use leaf-on-ink.

tokens.name: on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a leaf fill: always the dark one (5.8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: leaf-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text: links and positive values on paper (5.6:1 light, 9.9:1 dark) and leaf-soft (4.6 / 6.7).

tokens.name: leaf-on-ink
tokens.usage: Green on ink blocks (toasts, ink cards, ink stat tiles): text, icons and focus rings (5.8:1 light, 5.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels, selected rows and tag backgrounds behind ink or leaf-ink text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Pale marker yellow, always behind on-highlight text (16.3:1 light, 14.1:1 dark): a marker stroke under a word or two (rb-mark), the leading row of a table, a sticker (rb-sticker, ink ring). Never text, and never a bare block on a light ground (1.1:1, it disappears). One per screen.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight: always the dark one.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; as text on paper (5.0:1 light, 7.9:1 dark). Always paired with a word or icon. Orange so it never relies on a green/red difference. Text on an alert fill is paper.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts, behind ink text (15.7:1 light, 13.1:1 dark). The alert icon on it is 4.4 / 6.5:1.

tokens.name: team-1
tokens.usage: Team 1 (navy; a brighter blue in dark): team badges, bars and dots. Text on it is on-team-1. Always shown with the team's initial or name, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-team-1
tokens.usage: Text and initials on team-1 (9.4:1 light, 4.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: team-2
tokens.usage: Team 2 (sky): team badges, bars and dots. Light, so badges keep their 2px ink ring on paper in the light theme (2.2:1 without it).

tokens.name: on-team-2
tokens.usage: Text and initials on team-2 (8.0:1 light, 11.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: team-3
tokens.usage: Team 3 (orange): team badges, bars and dots. Light, so badges keep their 2px ink ring on paper in the light theme (2.2:1 without it). Not an error colour: errors use alert plus an icon.

tokens.name: on-team-3
tokens.usage: Text and initials on team-3 (8.2:1 light, 8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: team-4
tokens.usage: Team 4 (magenta; pinker in dark): team badges, bars and dots. Text on it is on-team-4.

tokens.name: on-team-4
tokens.usage: Text and initials on team-4 (5.4:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags and eyebrows, set in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, card padding on small screens, stack gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding, section gutters and the gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, colour blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and toggles: always fully round.
